cases.sentence: Я снова поднял глаза и увидел. Передо мной муж с землемерной нитью в ___
cases.translation: I lifted up my eyes again and saw. Before me a man with a measuring line in his hand
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) takes the prepositional case for location.

cases.sentence: Я спросил, Куда ты идешь? Он ответил мне, Измерить ___, чтобы узнать его ширину и длину
cases.translation: I asked, Where are you going? He answered me, To measure Jerusalem to know its width and length
cases.explain: The accusative case follows the verb 'измерить' (to measure).

cases.sentence: Беги, скажи тому юноше, Иерусалим будет городом без стен из-за множества жителей скота в ___
cases.translation: Run, tell that young man, Jerusalem will be a city without walls because of the multitude of people and livestock in it
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Я сам буду огненной стеной вокруг него и славой внутри ___ Иерусалима
cases.translation: I myself will be a wall of fire around it and glory within Jerusalem
Come, flee from the land of the north
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from, out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Вперед, спасайся, Сион, живущий у дочери ___
cases.translation: Come, escape, Zion, dwelling with the daughter of Babylon
cases.explain: The genitive shows possession: 'daughter of Babylon'.

cases.translation: These are the nations that plundered you
cases.explain: The relative clause uses the past tense to describe those who plundered them.

cases.sentence: Многие народы примкнут к ___ в тот день и станут Моим народом
cases.translation: Many nations shall join themselves to the Lord in that day and become My people
cases.explain: The verb 'примкнуть к' (join to) takes the dative case.

reading.ru: Я снова поднял глаза и увидел. Передо мной муж с землемерной нитью в руке.
reading.question: What does Zechariah see in this vision?
options: A man with a measuring line in his hand
reading.correct: A man with a measuring line in his hand
reading.explain: Zechariah clearly states 'Передо мной муж с землемерной нитью в руке' (Before me a man with a measuring line in his hand).

reading.ru: Куда ты идешь? Он ответил мне, Измерить Иерусалим, чтобы узнать его ширину и длину.
reading.question: What is the man's purpose?
options: To measure Jerusalem to determine its width and length
reading.correct: To measure Jerusalem to determine its width and length
reading.explain: The man explicitly says 'Измерить Иерусалим, чтобы узнать его ширину и длину' (To measure Jerusalem to know its width and length).

reading.ru: Иерусалим будет городом без стен из-за множества жителей скота. Я сам буду огненной стеной вокруг него, возвещает Господь, и славой внутри его.
reading.question: What makes Jerusalem's city walls unnecessary?
options: The great multitude of people and livestock that will dwell there
Strong gates will be built instead
A garrison of soldiers will protect it
reading.correct: The great multitude of people and livestock that will dwell there
reading.explain: The angel says 'Иерусалим будет городом без стен из-за множества жителей скота' (Jerusalem will be a city without walls because of the multitude of inhabitants and livestock).

reading.ru: Потому что кто прикасается к вам, тот касается зеницы моего ока.
reading.question: How does God describe His relationship to His people?
options: Anyone who touches them touches the apple of His eye
He watches them from a distance
He protects them only when they obey
He has given them to others
reading.correct: Anyone who touches them touches the apple of His eye
reading.explain: God says 'кто прикасается к вам, тот касается зеницы моего ока' (whoever touches you touches the apple of My eye), indicating they are precious to Him.

reading.ru: Кричи от радости и ликуй, дочь Сиона, ведь я приду и буду жить у тебя, возвещает Господь.
reading.question: What does God promise to the daughter of Zion?
options: He will come and dwell within her
She will be exiled for many years
She must wait for a distant fulfillment
Peace will never come to her
reading.correct: He will come and dwell within her
reading.explain: God directly promises 'я приду и буду жить у тебя' (I will come and dwell within you) to Zion.

reading.ru: Господь примет Иудею, как свой удел в святой земле, и снова изберет Иерусалим.
reading.question: What is God's ultimate commitment to Judah and Jerusalem?
options: He will claim Judah as His inheritance in the holy land and choose Jerusalem again
He will give them to another nation
reading.correct: He will claim Judah as His inheritance in the holy land and choose Jerusalem again
reading.explain: God declares 'Господь примет Иудею, как свой удел в святой земле, и снова изберет Иерусалим' (The Lord will claim Judah as His portion in the holy land and choose Jerusalem again).
